# Release notes

The newest release is first. In Odoo the version number starts with the Odoo version, so release 1.1.0 for Odoo 20.0 shows as `20.0.1.1.0`.

## 3.0.1

*2026-10-26, Odoo 13.0 - 20.0*

- Odoo 13.0, 14.0 and 15.0 versions.
- The scale stays on when IoT Box settings are saved.

## 3.0.0

*2026-10-24, Odoo 16.0 - 20.0*

- Installs on Odoo Community without an IoT Box.
- Scale profiles.
- Licensed under AGPL-3.
- Odoo 16.0, 17.0, 18.0 and 20.0 versions.

## 2.1.0

*2026-08-11, Odoo 19.0*

- Free release.
- Fixed automatic reconnection to the scale.

## 1.10.0

*2026-08-07, Odoo 19.0*

- Fixed compatibility with Odoo Community.
